input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The only licence grant (section 2, p0002) runs to "Customer" alone — a defined term limited to The Associated Press itself, with no affiliate or contractor coverage and no notice mechanic to add them — and it is expressly "non-transferable, non-assignable", so the licence cannot follow Customer into a merger or acquisition. The general assignment clause (p0072) permits assignment of the Agreement to a successor, but the specific licence prohibition overrides it for the licence itself, so the successor-transfer element is not already met. The clause therefore fails both fallback elements. We took the fallback target: affiliates covered on written notice and transferability to an M&A successor, in one surgical edit. We deliberately did not chase the preferred position (deleting "revocable" and limiting revocation to uncured material breach) because that would require collateral conforming rewrites of section 4(a)'s mutual post-Initial-Term termination right and section 4(c)(ii)'s revocation-on-termination mechanic; we note the licence remains revocable, which is short of preferred.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to Customer affiliates identified by written notice and make it transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The licence runs to Customer alone and is expressly non-transferable and non-assignable, so it fails our licence-scope fallback. We have extended it to affiliates identified in written notice to Kubient and made it transferable to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, leaving the rest of the grant untouched.

ops.oldText: In the event Customer shall utilize Kubient's ad serving technology as part of the Services, Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
ops.newText: In the event Customer shall utilize Kubient's ad serving technology as part of the Services, Kubient hereby grants to Customer, and to any affiliate of Customer identified in written notice to Kubient, a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, without right of sublicense, revocable license, transferable to a successor of Customer by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
